name: Mining Consulting Project
description: Comprehensive mining consulting from scoping through detailed engineering, construction support, and brownfield maintenance. Covers FEL 1-3, EPC execution, commissioning, and sustaining capital projects.

tasks.name: Phase 1: Scoping / Concept Study (FEL 1)
tasks.description: Identify trade-offs, define broad mechanical options, and eliminate fatal flaws

children.name: Project kickoff & objectives
children.description: Stakeholder alignment, scope confirmation, success criteria

children.name: Draft Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs)
children.description: Preliminary BFDs for ore handling and process routes

children.name: Major equipment sizing
children.description: High-level sizing: primary crushers, SAG/Ball mills, flotation cells, tailings thickeners

children.name: Bulk material handling logistics
children.description: Conveyor corridors, rail loadouts, port facilities assessment

children.name: Trade-off screening studies
children.description: Eliminate fatal flaws, identify viable process routes

children.name: High-level CAPEX estimate
children.description: ±30% to ±50% mechanical CAPEX estimate

children.name: Concept study report
children.description: Deliver concept study report for FEL 2 gate

tasks.name: Phase 2: Pre-Feasibility Study (PFS / FEL 2)
tasks.description: Evaluate options and select the single preferred mechanical configuration

children.name: PFS kickoff & planning
children.description: Team mobilization, work plan finalization

children.name: Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)
children.description: Develop PFDs for preferred and alternative routes

children.name: Mechanical mass/heat balances
children.description: Establish mass and heat balances for all streams

children.name: Equipment datasheets (long-lead)
children.description: Crushers, mills, slurry pumps, screens datasheets

children.name: Equipment trade-off studies
children.description: SAG vs HPGR; Overland Conveyors vs Haulage; other key decisions

children.name: Plant general arrangement (GA)
children.description: GA drawings and 3D site layout models

children.name: Refined CAPEX/OPEX estimates
children.description: ±15% to ±25% mechanical estimates

children.name: PFS report & gate review
children.description: Deliver PFS report for FEL 3 gate

tasks.name: Phase 3: Front-End Engineering Design (FEED / FEL 3)
tasks.description: Finalize baseline engineering package for Final Investment Decision (FID)

children.name: FEED kickoff & baseline
children.description: Confirm design basis, standards, and project controls

children.name: P&ID finalization
children.description: Finalize Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams

children.name: Mechanical equipment lists
children.description: Complete mechanical equipment list with tag numbers

children.name: RFQ preparation & issue
children.description: Formal RFQs for major capital equipment

children.name: FEA/CFD analysis
children.description: Finite Element Analysis and CFD for critical structures, chutes, slurry pipelines

children.name: HAZOP & design reviews
children.description: Hazard and Operability Analysis, Constructability Reviews, Maintainability Audits

children.name: FEED package delivery
children.description: Complete FEED package for FID

tasks.name: Phase 4: Detailed Engineering & Procurement (EPC/EPCM)
tasks.description: Produce construction-ready deliverables and procure mechanical packages

children.name: Detailed engineering kickoff
children.description: Mobilize detailed engineering team

children.name: Vendor GA drawing review
children.description: Review vendor general arrangement drawings and technical bids

children.name: Piping isometrics & stress
children.description: Detailed piping isometric drawings, stress analyses, pipe support details

children.name: Chute design & fabrication
children.description: Detailed chute design, liner selection, platework fabrication drawings

children.name: Mechanical procurement
children.description: Procure all mechanical packages and equipment

children.name: Factory Acceptance Testing
children.description: FAT for overhead cranes, pump skids, thickeners, major packages

tasks.name: Phase 5: Construction Support & Commissioning
tasks.description: Bring mechanical systems online safely and hand over to operations

children.name: Construction support
children.description: On-site mechanical engineering support during construction

children.name: Cold commissioning (No-Load)
children.description: Uncoupled motor rotations, dry conveyors, hydrostatic testing, alignment checks

children.name: Hot commissioning (Load)
children.description: Slurry testing, ore feed, crusher CSS tuning, vibration/temperature monitoring

children.name: Punch listing & handover
children.description: Punch list, operational handover, As-Built drawing updates

children.name: Ramp-up support
children.description: Production ramp-up support and performance testing

tasks.name: Phase 6: Maintenance & Sustaining Capital (Brownfield)
tasks.description: Asset integrity, debottlenecking, and planned shutdowns for operating plant

children.name: Condition assessment & audits
children.description: NDT, vibration analysis, ultrasonic thickness, thermography audits

children.name: Root Cause Failure Analysis
children.description: RCFA for repeating failures: gearboxes, slurry pipes, chute plugging

children.name: Debottlenecking studies
children.description: Conveyor speed increases, pump impeller modifications, throughput studies

children.name: 3D laser scanning
children.description: Scan existing brownfield geometry to avoid clashes

children.name: Sustaining capital engineering
children.description: Design retrofits: drop-in chutes, screen decks, conveyor pulleys

children.name: Shutdown planning
children.description: JSAs, lifting plans, work packs, spare parts procurement

children.name: Shutdown execution
children.description: Mill liners, crusher mantles, conveyor belts, shaft alignment, seal replacements

children.name: Reliability engineering
children.description: PM tasks, FMEA, spare optimization, Condition Monitoring Systems

risks.title: Site access restrictions
risks.mitigationPlan: Early permit applications, community engagement, alternative access routes

risks.title: Data quality issues
risks.mitigationPlan: Data validation protocols, gap analysis, additional testwork

risks.title: Regulatory compliance gaps
risks.mitigationPlan: Early regulator engagement, compliance audits, gap closure plans

risks.title: Client scope changes
risks.mitigationPlan: Change control process, clear scope boundaries, impact assessments

risks.title: Vendor delivery delays
risks.mitigationPlan: Early procurement, long-lead identification, alternative vendors

risks.title: Brownfield fitment clashes
risks.mitigationPlan: 3D laser scanning, clash detection, modular pre-assembly

risks.title: Repeated mechanical failures
risks.mitigationPlan: RCFA, OEM engagement, upgraded materials, condition monitoring

risks.title: Lifting plan failures
risks.mitigationPlan: Engineered lift plans, rigging inspections, exclusion zones

risks.title: Slurry pipeline erosion
risks.mitigationPlan: CFD modeling, wear-resistant materials, monitoring programs
